questions.subject: Mathematics Standard
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Number Systems. which of the following is irrational?
questions.explanation: √3 cannot be expressed as a ratio of two integers.

questions.subject: Mathematics Standard
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Number Systems. the decimal expansion of 13/125 is:
questions.explanation: 125 = 5³, so the fraction has a terminating decimal expansion.

questions.subject: Mathematics Standard
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Polynomials. the degree of 5x³ − 2x + 7 is:
questions.explanation: The highest power of x with a non-zero coefficient is 3.

questions.subject: Mathematics Standard
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Coordinate Geometry. the point (0, −4) lies on the:
questions.explanation: Its x-coordinate is zero, so it lies on the y-axis.

questions.subject: Mathematics Standard
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Linear Equations in Two Variables. which ordered pair satisfies x + y = 5?

questions.subject: Mathematics Standard
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Lines and Angles. if two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, alternate interior angles are:
questions.explanation: Alternate interior angles are equal when the lines are parallel.

questions.subject: Mathematics Standard
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Triangles. two triangles are congruent by SAS when:

options.B: Two corresponding sides and included angle are equal
options.D: One side and one angle are equal

questions.explanation: SAS congruence requires two sides and the included angle to match.

questions.subject: Mathematics Standard
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Quadrilaterals. the sum of interior angles of a quadrilateral is:
questions.explanation: A quadrilateral can be divided into two triangles; total = 2 × 180°.

questions.subject: Mathematics Standard
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Areas of Parallelograms and Triangles. parallelograms on the same base and between the same parallels have:
questions.explanation: They have the same base and height, so their areas are equal.

questions.subject: Mathematics Standard
questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Circles. the perpendicular from the centre of a circle to a chord:
questions.explanation: A perpendicular from the centre to a chord bisects the chord.

questions.question: March challenge: During board-exam readiness, a Class 9 learner is reviewing Probability. a fair die is rolled once. Probability of getting an even number is:
